description.en: Represents a single Engagement (either formal Consultation or informal engagement) between two specific parties, that forms part of the overall Project Engagement phase.
Activity of engaging a third part as part of an Archaeological Project. This could be a formal First Nations Consultation, or an informal engagement with a FN or other third party.
